acceptance_criteria: One health request calls runtime.getHealthSnapshot exactly once in every runtime mode.
A runtime transition injected between dependency evaluation steps cannot create a mixed-generation response.
Top-level status, degradation causes, runtime data, turn capability, and enrichment runtime status bind to the same sample generation.
Enrichment backlog is queried once through #2514's typed observation contract, with failure distinct from measured zero.
A recovery transition produces either a complete earlier degraded generation or a complete later healthy generation, never a hybrid.
Observation start, end, duration, and serialization time have explicit semantics and clock-skew tests.
Concurrent request tests prove snapshots do not share mutable observation state across requests.
Runtime snapshot exceptions produce typed readiness-unavailable state while #2515's public process liveness remains answerable.
Mutation tests fail if a projection re-calls the runtime or re-queries an already-owned probe.
Exact-byte tests contain only reserved opaque observation identifiers and no identity, content, location, process, credential, or topology values.
blast_radius: Instance health readiness, cause projection, runtime and turn-capability serialization, enrichment state, database probe load, fleet and alert interpretation, and recovery-clear coherence.
evidence_summary: Three stable live identity reads pinned open issue #2545 to node I_kwDOR1Sep88AAAABKQyDMw, its current title, P2, SSOT, audit, bug, and reliability labels, update time, URL, and exact 8,474-byte body hash while the SSH remote main remained de3f69bbb5648b804ea2843d310c47dda544a056. The prior audited main and this revision have identical bytes for every decisive and affected path. Exact-main source inspection shows getEnrichmentStats samples runtime first, then the health handler independently samples runtime again; first-sample runtimeDegraded participates in top-level status while the second sample supplies serialized runtime data. A source-extracted exact-main canary injected a degraded first sample and healthy second sample and proved two runtime calls, the contradictory values, the source order, one generated_at timestamp, and no observation-generation binding. The exact core suite passed 144 of 144 tests. A fresh fully paginated scan covered all 36 open pull requests and 1,276 changed-file rows, found ten touched-path collisions plus taxonomy coordination in draft PR #2451, and found no implementation owner.
falsifier_or_remaining_gap: The finding would be falsified if every request sampled runtime exactly once and all status and projection fields derived from that immutable value. Exact source execution instead produced runtime_calls=2 with first_sample_degraded=true and second_sample_healthy=true. Existing tests establish adapter and health behavior separately but do not inject a transition through the complete request, and this review did not add concurrent-request or mutation fixtures.
impact: One response can carry healthy serialized runtime state while retaining degradation from an earlier sample, or mix older enrichment fields with newer runtime state. Consumers cannot distinguish a real transition from an internally incoherent observation.
lead_verification_obligations: Re-read issue #2545 immediately before registry integration and reject this record if its state, node ID, title, labels, update time, URL, or exact body hash changed.
Reconfirm the SSH origin, local origin/main, remote main, and every decisive path byte before implementation.
Re-scan all open pull requests and merged PR #2051 immediately before dispatch; preserve a single implementation owner.
Consume #2514's typed database observation rather than creating a second availability or measured-zero contract.
Land the request-scoped observation mechanism before #2538 depends on generation-coherent runtime causes; keep #2473 and #2522 downstream aggregation ownership separate.
Coordinate #2515's public-liveness and privileged-diagnostics split without binding sensitive fields into the observation identifier.
Add RED and GREEN tests for one runtime call per mode, injected recovery transitions, probe exceptions, concurrent requests, clock skew, and generation mismatches.
Require mutation tests to fail if runtime or an already-owned database probe is sampled again.
Run all decisive suites plus broader health, bootstrap, and integration checks against committed implementation bytes.
